title.narrative: Flexible Funding Programme. This will deploy world-leading experts with UK government officials, to deliver programmes to increase trade

description.narrative: Programme will deploy world-leading experts from private, public, academic and third sectors with UK govt. officials. The Flexible Funding programme is part of the Global Trade Programme (GTP) and will provide technical assistance and other support to increase free trade and open markets for Official Development Assistance-eligible Middle Income Countries, creating jobs and reducing poverty. The GTP will also deliver secondary benefits increasing market access for international businesses, including from the UK. This will generate opportunities for international businesses in the intellectual property, standards, customs and regulations sectors, bringing potential benefits to British business in sectors where they are well placed to compete
